MINUTES
  ADJOURNED PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION
  July 17, 2017

 An adjourned meeting of the Park and Activities Commission of the City of Rolling Hills Estates
 was called to order at 6:10 p.m. at Highridge Park, 29035 Highridge Rd., Rolling Hills Estates,
 California, by CHAIR POPE.

 Connor Spencer led those present in a salute to the flag.

 COMMISSIONERS PRESENT:  Chair Pope, Romanelli, Giglia, Retz and Wroan

 COMMISSIONERS ABSENT:  Portugal, Persichina,

 STAFF PRESENT:  Andy Clark, Community Services Director

 PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION DRAFT MINUTES, JUNE 19, 2017

  COMMISSIONER GIGLIA moved, seconded by COMMISSIONER ROMANELLI to,

  APPROVE THE PARK & ACTIVITES MEETING MINUTES OF JUNE 19, 2017.

  THERE BEING NO OBJECTION, CHAIR POPE SO ORDERED.

 AUDIENCE ITEMS/WRITTEN COMMUNICATIONS NOT ON THE AGENDA

 None.

 CONSENT CALENDAR

A.  STREET TREE REMOVAL APPLICATION

Community Services Director Clark provided the Park & Activities Commission with a brief
summary of the request to remove three street trees at property address, 15 Ranchview Road.
There are a total of five street trees surrounding the property; two will remain.

COMMISSIONER ROMANELLI asked if the two remaining trees will cause no damage to the
drainage line.

Ryan Willis, Property Owner, stated that the two remaining trees are not causing damage to the
drainage line.

CHAIR POPE inquired about the City’s policy to replace the trees.

Community Services Director Clark stated that the policy of the City is that the trees be replaced
with new trees to be planted at a location in close proximity to the property where they were
removed.

COMMISSIONER GIGLIA moved, seconded by COMMISSIONER RETZ to,

  APPROVE THE REMOVAL OF THE THREE IDENTIFIED STREET TREES LOCATED
  IN FRONT OF 15 RANCHVIEW ROAD AND THE PURCHASE OF THREE TREES FOR
  PLANTING IN OTHER NEARBY PUBLIC PARKWAYS OR MEDIANS AT THE COST OF
  THE APPLICANT.

  THERE BEING NO OBJECTION, CHAIR POPE SO ORDERED.

BUSINESS ITEMS

A. CHARITY PI RUN EVENT

 Community Services Director Clark provided the Park & Activities Commission with a brief
 summary of the request to waive or reduce the race clock rental fee for a fundraising event
 scheduled on March 16, 2016 for Hiefer International and Doctors without Borders.

ADJOURNED PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION MEETING
MINUTES
JULY 17, 2017  1
  The Park & Activities Commission held a brief discussion on this item.

 COMMISSIONER ROMANELLI moved and seconded by COMMISSIONER GIGLIA to,

  APPROVE CONNOR SPENCER’S USE OF THE ERNIE HOWLETT PARK PERIMETER
  PATHWAY FOR THE PI CHARITY RACE ON SUNDAY, MARCH 11, 2018 UNDER THE
  CONDITIONS IN THE STAFF REPORT AND TO NOT APPROVE THE REQUEST TO
  WAIVE OR REDUCE THE RACE CLOCK RENTAL FEE.

 THERE BEING NO OBJECTION, CHAIR POPE SO ORDERED.

 COMMISSIONER POPE suggested that the fee structure be reviewed in order to determine if
 there should be a separate fee for “for-profit” and “non-profit” organizations. Community
 Services Director Clark stated that this will be added to a future agenda.

B. SILVER SPUR LITTLE LEAGUE AGE GROUP CHANGES

Community Services Director Clark stated that prior to the meeting, Commissioner Persichina
requested that this item be discussed at the next Park & Activities Commission meeting.

The Park & Activities Commission agreed to include this item in the next Park & Activities
Commission meeting agenda.

C. EQUESTRIAN COMMITTEE ACTION ITEM FROM MEETING OF JUNE 26, 2017

Community Services Director Clark provided a brief summary of a request made to the Park &
Activities Commission by the Equestrian Subcommittee at their June 26, 2017 meeting, which
includes enforcement of business licenses for businesses who provide specialized equestrian
services in the City.

The Park & Activities Commission discussed this item and determined that this is a matter of
being consistent and fair in the requirement for professional businesses obtaining a business
license in order to conduct business within the City.

  COMMISSIONER GIGLIA moved, seconded by COMMISSIONER RETZ to,

  APPROVE STAFF’S RECOMMENDATION.
  THERE BEING NO OBJECTION, CHAIR POPE SO ORDERED.

D. OUTDOOR EDUCATION FACILITIES GRANT APPLICATION

Community Services Director Clark stated that this item was postponed from an earlier meeting
in order to provide the Park & Activities Commission time to consider other potential
improvements to the City’s parks.

COMMISSIONER ROMANELLI stated that the signage at the tennis courts at Ernie Howlett Park
are in need of repair/replacement. Community Services Director Clark stated that this type of
signage will not qualify for the grant, but that he will request that the signs be replaced. A sample
of the sign verbiage will be provided at a future meeting for the Commissioner’s to review.

COMMISSIONER RETZ moved and seconded by COMMISSIONER ROMANELLI to,

  APPROVE STAFF’S RECOMMENDATION AS STATED IN THE STAFF REPORT.

THERE BEING NO OBJECTION, CHAIR POPE SO ORDERED.

COMMISSION ITEMS (VERBAL REPORTS)

A.  ADOPT-A-PARK REPORT

COMMISSIONER RETZ stated that he is pleased with the fencing.

COMMISSIONER POPE stated that there is good progress being made on the brush removal
along Hawthorne Blvd.

ADJOURNED PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION MEETING
MINUTES
JULY 17, 2017  2
 DIRECTOR’S ITEMS (VERBAL REPORTS)

A.  TRACY AUSTIN DOUBLES TENNIS TOURNAMENT CONCESSIONS, JULY 22-23

CHAIR POPE AND COMMISSIONER RETZ volunteered for the afternoon shift.
B.  HILLS ARE ALIVE RACE SIGN-UP

CHAIR POPE, COMMISSIONERS ROMANELLI AND GIGLIA signed up to volunteer.

TOUR OF HIGHRIDGE PARK

Tour of Highridge Park – Items noted for repair or replacement,

  •  City sticker on Little Libraries.
  •  Rotting wood on restroom building.
  •  Hand towels need to be replenished in restroom.
  •  Leak from water fountain valve (near restroom building).
  •  Concrete missing near balance beam.
  •  Replace water fountains with ADA compliant water fountains.
  •  Contact Waste Management to replace blue bin lids.
  •  Add additional “Pooper Scooper” station.
  •  Repair buried concrete curbs.
  •  Wet area on back end of the park (possible leak).
  •  New gopher holes on back end of the park.
  •  Check on irrigation on back end of the park; one side green and other side is dry.
  •  Graffiti (yellow) on softball back stop.
  •  Plaster on back of back stop peeling.
  •  Graffiti (yellow) on push-up bars (behind 3rd base).
  •  Nails on rails need to be removed.
  •  Possible illegal drains from property on north side of the park.
  •  “Electro-matic” cabinet needs to be removed.

ADJOURNMENT

CHAIR POPE adjourned the meeting at 7:20 p.m. to the adjourned Park & Activities Commission
Meeting on August 21, 2017 at 6:00 p.m. at the City of Rolling Hills Estates Council Chambers,
4045 Palos Verdes Drive North, Rolling Hills Estates, CA 90274.

 Respectfully submitted,  Approved,

 __________________________  _________________________
 Carol Corea  Heidi Luce
 Minutes Secretary  City Clerk
